This tragedy highlights the extreme risks faced in high-altitude expeditions.

title: RBI deposit rules: Differential rates, daily disclosures changes explained
description: The Reserve Bank of India has revised rules for bulk deposits, effective October 2026. Banks can now offer differential interest rates based on liquidity risk under the LCR framework. This move aligns deposit pricing with revised LCR guidelines for better asset-liability management. Mandatory daily public disclosure of bulk deposit rates will enhance transparency for customers. However, uniform rates will continue for similarly placed depositors across all branches.

title: 'Mekedatu project permanent solution': Shivakumar on Cauvery water dispute

This project aims to bring both states to the table for amicable discussions.  The Cauvery water dispute centers on sharing river waters during periods of low rainfall.

title: FPIs return to India: Rs 20,200 cr injected into equities after months of selling

Overseas developments and domestic events will guide future investment directions.

The film has shown encouraging trends on its second Sunday, maintaining steady collections. Jana Nayagan's second weekend provided fresh momentum, boosting its overall earnings significantly. Positive family footfalls and sustained fan interest keep the film in a strong position. The action drama is expected to cross the Rs 200 crore India gross mark very soon.

Police have launched an investigation and are recording statements from all parties. Further action will be taken after evidence collection and examination.

They are also expected to add nearly twenty-three thousand new housing units. Lucknow registered more projects but attracted less overall investment. Infrastructure development and proximity to Delhi fuel this continued dominance.

title: Jeff Bezos warns Mamdani on NYC taxes, slams wasteful spending
description: Jeff Bezos commented on New York City's proposed pied-à-terre tax. He suggested that aggressive tax increases could negatively impact tourism and competitiveness. Bezos also criticized targeting individuals, calling it a villain strategy. He argued that government spending inefficiencies are a greater concern than taxation. Bezos previously criticized the city's public school spending and economic policies.

title: Bobby Fischer: The champion America summoned, and Iceland sheltered
description: Henry Kissinger once urged Bobby Fischer to face the Soviets. It was a small island, not his homeland, that gave him a resting place. In the second column of The Grandmaster View, India's 93rd Grandmaster Aarav Dengla traces Fischer's journey from Cold War hero to exiled genius. his revolutionary impact on chess, the tragedy of his later years, and why the country that embraced him in death offered the sense of belonging that his own homeland ultimately could not.

title: 'PM gave her jeevandaan': Noida teen's mother thanks Modi, wants him to 'adopt her'

She requested stricter social media controls for minors and their exclusion from protests.

The fast-moving Old Trails Fire in Spokane threatened thousands of structures and forced evacuations. Power utility Avista implemented safety shutoffs, leaving many customers without electricity. Officials confirmed some structures were destroyed as the extent of damage was assessed.

title: Gurgaon MNC employee dies by suicide, son records video as mother screams for help
description: A Gurugram man was found hanging after his wife sought a divorce. His seven-year-old son reportedly recorded a video of the incident. The deceased's sister alleges foul play and disputes the suicide claim. Police have detained the wife and are investigating the circumstances thoroughly. The post-mortem report is awaited to determine the exact cause of death.

title: After AGI division layoffs and Lab shutdown, Amazon is refocusing its AI strategy
description: Amazon's AI division is undergoing significant restructuring and consolidation.  Several flagship in-house models are being phased out and specialized research groups are closing.  Compute power and technical staff are now focused on a single frontier model initiative.  This strategic shift aims to maintain pace with industry rivals and evolving customer needs.  Renowned AI roboticist Pieter Abbeel will lead this new frontier model research effort.

title: 'Buy police uniforms, head to Jantar Mantar': Inside 'Pakistan-linked' terror plot
description: West Bengal Police STF arrested Arpita Sarkar, girlfriend of suspected terrorist Hamim Mondal.  Investigators are probing their alleged plan to create disturbances at Jantar Mantar.  Hamim was reportedly working under instructions from Pakistani handlers via social media.  Arpita is also suspected of involvement in a honey-trap network targeting influential people.  The investigation is ongoing, and more arrests are anticipated in the coming days.

title: 8 dead as heavy rain wreaks havoc, triggers landslides, floods across Kerala
description: Kerala faces severe rain and flooding, resulting in at least eight fatalities. Landslides and inundation have caused widespread damage across several districts. Rescue operations are underway for stranded residents and missing fishermen. Authorities have opened relief camps and issued alerts for continuing rainfall. Tourist destinations remain temporarily closed due to the ongoing adverse weather conditions.

title: Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours
description: Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. The company noted generated images were watermarked as AI-created.

title: When a district in Florida's Everglades used robot rabbits to eliminate Burmese pythons
description: Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic prey using heat and scent to lure snakes. When a python is detected, officials are alerted to remove the invasive species. This technology complements the annual Python Challenge, which has removed thousands of snakes. These efforts aim to control the python population impacting native wildlife.
